items.question: What services does QuadIQ Advisory provide?
items.answer: We offer audit & assurance, accounting & outsourcing, tax advisory, financial advisory, governance risk & compliance (GRC), and specialty advisory including forensic, ESG, and infrastructure support. Each practice is partner-led and tailored to your stage of growth.

items.question: Which industries and company sizes do you work with?
items.answer: We serve SMEs and established corporates across manufacturing, technology, services, infrastructure, and regulated sectors. Engagements range from outsourced bookkeeping and GST compliance to statutory audits, valuations, and transaction advisory.

items.question: How is QuadIQ Advisory different from a large Big Four firm?
items.answer: You work directly with experienced chartered accountants — not layers of junior staff. We combine institutional-grade rigour with the agility, responsiveness, and cost efficiency that mid-market businesses need, without sacrificing independence or technical depth.

items.question: Do you serve clients outside Gurugram?
items.answer: Yes. While our office is in Udyog Vihar, Gurugram, we advise clients across India. Many engagements are delivered through a mix of on-site visits, secure document exchange, and virtual meetings.

items.question: How do I get started with an engagement?
items.answer: Reach out via our contact form, email at [info@quadiqadvisory.com](mailto:info@quadiqadvisory.com), or WhatsApp at +91 7827279427. We will schedule an initial conversation to understand your needs and propose a scope of work.

items.question: What should I prepare for an initial consultation?
items.answer: A brief overview of your business, current pain points, and any upcoming deadlines (audit, tax filing, transaction, etc.) is helpful. If relevant, recent financial statements or compliance notices allow us to give more specific guidance.

items.question: Do you handle statutory audits and tax filings?
items.answer: Yes. Our audit & assurance team conducts statutory and financial statement audits under applicable standards. Our tax practice covers direct and indirect tax planning, GST returns, transfer pricing, and representation before authorities.

items.question: How do you ensure confidentiality and data security?
items.answer: We treat client information with strict confidentiality, aligned with professional standards governing chartered accountants. Data is shared through secure channels, and access is limited to engagement team members on a need-to-know basis.
